bio: You might, for a moment, feel as if you have stumbled across a wine cellar, but you will soon see that this hip South American eatery is very much at home in this cosmopolitan city. Nazka unleashes a whirlwind of bold flavours on your palate, from pisco cocktails to ceviche and other Peruvian specialities. This is exhilarating cuisine featuring a captivating interplay of spicy and sweet chilli peppers, Asian umami and the zing of leche del tigre. The well-curated selection of wines from around the globe adds extra character to this unique dining experience....
